title: FastAPI services
description: Checks for API response schemas, resource lifespan and request behavior.

rules.instruction: Declare the response model for JSON endpoints that return application data. Expose the promised fields and keep private persistence fields outside the schema.
rules.verification: Inspect the generated OpenAPI operation and assert the response shape with a representative record containing internal fields.

rules.instruction: Open and close shared resources through the project's FastAPI lifespan mechanism. Keep request-scoped state attached to the request or its dependencies.
rules.verification: Exercise startup and shutdown in an integration test and confirm that an initialization failure prevents the app from serving requests.

rules.instruction: Test changes through the application entry point using its configured route dependencies and test services.
rules.verification: Check a representative success response, a validation failure and any authorization rules affected by the change.
